style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;labelBackgroundColor=#CCFFCC;fontSize=18;" value="<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"></p><div style="text-align: center;"><b>LEGEND</b></div><ul><li><b>Frontend delivery</b></li></ul><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">1. HTTPS GET, load app</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">2. CloudFront fetches React build from private bucket (OAC)</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">3. HTML, JS, CSS returned</p></blockquote><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"></p><ul><li><b>Authentication</b></li></ul><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">4. Login, email and password</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">5. JWT ID token returned</p></blockquote><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"></p><ul><li><b>API request path</b></li></ul><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">6. HTTPS request with Bearer JWT</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">7. Validate JWT against Cognito (JWKS), dashed</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">8. Route GET/POST /patients</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">9. Route GET/POST /appointments</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">10. Route GET/POST /records</p>Authorization: all three services restrict POST/writes to the doctors group (checked in each Lambda from verified JWT claims); GET/reads allowed for any authenticated user.<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><b style="background-color: light-dark(rgb(204, 255, 204), rgb(0, 43, 0)); color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">Data access</b></p></blockquote><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">11. Patient Lambda reads/writes patients table</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">12. Appointment Lambda reads/writes appointments table</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">13. Records Lambda reads/writes records table</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">14. Records Lambda generates presigned URL, 300s, dashed</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">15. Browser uploads file directly to S3</p></blockquote><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"></p><ul><li><b>Security and observability</b></li></ul><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">16. KMS encrypts data at rest, AES-256 CMK</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">17. Patient role assumed by patient Lambda, least privilege</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">18. Appointment role assumed by appointment Lambda</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">19. Records role assumed by records Lambda</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">20. Lambdas send logs and metrics to CloudWatch, async</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">21. CloudWatch alarm triggers SNS</p></blockquote><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">22. SNS notifies email subscriber</p></blockquote><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"></p><ul><li><b>CI/CD</b></li></ul><p></p><blockquote style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 40px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px;"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">23. Push or pull request triggers GitHub Actions</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">24. GitHub authenticates to AWS via OIDC, temporary credentials</p><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">25. Pipeline plans against remote state, read-only</p></blockquote>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1300" width="570" x="-1080" y="-135" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

blockquote.p: 1. HTTPS GET, load app
2. CloudFront fetches React build from private bucket (OAC)
3. HTML, JS, CSS returned
4. Login, email and password
5. JWT ID token returned

div.blockquote:
6. HTTPS request with Bearer JWT
7. Validate JWT against Cognito (JWKS), dashed
8. Route GET/POST /patients
9. Route GET/POST /appointments
10. Route GET/POST /recordsAuthorization: all three services restrict POST/writes to the doctors group (checked in each Lambda from verified JWT claims); GET/reads allowed for any authenticated user.
Data access

blockquote.p: 11. Patient Lambda reads/writes patients table
12. Appointment Lambda reads/writes appointments table
13. Records Lambda reads/writes records table
14. Records Lambda generates presigned URL, 300s, dashed
15. Browser uploads file directly to S3
16. KMS encrypts data at rest, AES-256 CMK
17. Patient role assumed by patient Lambda, least privilege
18. Appointment role assumed by appointment Lambda
19. Records role assumed by records Lambda
20. Lambdas send logs and metrics to CloudWatch, async
21. CloudWatch alarm triggers SNS
22. SNS notifies email subscriber
23. Push or pull request triggers GitHub Actions
24. GitHub authenticates to AWS via OIDC, temporary credentials
25. Pipeline plans against remote state, read-only
